{{Top|leg}}
'''Poths''' were predators from [[Frithia]] which, during famine, would [[Death/Legends|kill]] themselves to provide food for their young.

Many [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|females]] were named after the [[Species/Legends|species]].
